umbriel 0.1.0: a wayland compositor

Usage: umbriel [-s <command>] [-c <config>]   run the compositor
       umbriel msg <action> [args...]         send an action to the compositor
       umbriel windows                        list windows (app id and title)
       umbriel workspaces                     list workspaces and their layouts
       umbriel submap                         show the active keybind submap
       umbriel layers                         list layer-shell surfaces
       umbriel color                          show color-management state
       umbriel tearing                        show tearing-control state
       umbriel keyboard-layouts               list keyboard layouts
       umbriel output-create <name>           create a headless output (headless sessions only)
       umbriel output-destroy <name>          destroy an output (headless sessions only)
       umbriel subscribe <event>[,<event>…]   stream events as JSON lines
               events: theme, overview, keyboard_layout, windows, workspaces
       umbriel outputs                        list outputs and modes
       umbriel validate [-c <config>]         check the config file
       umbriel help | -h | --help             show this help
       umbriel -v | -V | --version            print version

Options:
  -s <command>   spawn <command> once the compositor starts
  -c <config>    use <config> instead of the default config path

Run `umbriel msg --help` to list all available actions for `msg` and keybinds.
